verdict.rationale: Trivy's own misconfiguration scanner docs say it ships built-in checks for configuration issues in IaC files, naming Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform and CloudFormation. That matches the story's named targets directly. Separate docs show Dockerfile-style misconfiguration checks on container image configs. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the IaC scan commands and check coverage or depth, and independent hands-on corroboration of Terraform/Kubernetes misconfiguration scanning.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can scan Terraform, Kubernetes, and other IaC files for security misconfigurations

citations.quote: Trivy provides built-in checks to detect configuration issues in popular Infrastructure as Code files, such as: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CloudFormation, and more.
Trivy detects misconfigurations on the configuration of container images.
